entry.name: Google AI Essentials
entry.note: A course certificate, not a proctored exam; a non-technical introduction to using generative AI at work
entry.audience: Anyone in a non-technical role who wants working fluency with generative AI

covers: Using generative AI tools to develop ideas and content
Applying prompting techniques like few-shot prompting
Using AI responsibly and identifying biases
Evaluating AI outputs and tool suitability
Leveraging AI for productivity and informed decisions
reading.format: Self-paced online program with hands-on activities; earn a certificate from Google upon completion.
reading.summary: Google AI Essentials is a self-paced program that teaches how to use generative AI tools for daily work tasks. It covers writing prompts, using AI responsibly, and applying AI to generate ideas and content. Completing the program earns a certificate from Google.
reading.audience: It is for people across roles and industries who are new to AI; no experience is required.
